I rewrote our onboarding email eleven times last year.

Version one was 400 words and explained everything. Version eleven is 38 words and explains nothing.

Version eleven has a 71% reply rate.

The 38 words: a question about what they were trying to do when they signed up, and a promise that a person would read the answer.

I read every answer. It takes me forty minutes a week and it has replaced two dashboards, one survey tool and an entire "voice of customer" initiative that had its own logo.

The onboarding email was never the product. The reply was.
